about_the_game:
Innovative Mutation System: Stack blocks that dynamically evolve through shape shifting, color changing, size morphing, and piece splitting, creating unpredictable and strategic gameplay.

  • Special Blocks for Tactical Play: Use bomb blocks to trigger explosive clears, lightning blocks to zap rows or columns, and rainbow blocks to eliminate matching colors, enhancing chain reaction combos.

  • 30 Dynamic Levels: Progress through 30 levels with color palettes that shift every five levels, offering a visually vibrant and ever changing puzzle experience.

  • Customizable Visual Styles: Switch between cyber and terminal themes to personalize your gameplay, complemented by smooth animations and particle effects.

  • Flexible Controls: Enjoy seamless gameplay with gamepad and keyboard support, including intuitive controls for movement, rotation, mutation triggers, and style switching.

  • Progressive Difficulty and Scoring: Face increasing challenges with a progressive difficulty system and maximize scores through strategic chain reaction combos.

    Special Block Types:

    •   Bomb Blocks: Create explosive chain reactions

    •   Lightning Blocks: Zap entire rows and columns

    •   Rainbow Blocks: Clear all blocks of the same color

    • Mutation System: Trigger piece mutations for tactical advantages:

    •   Shape Shifting

    •   Color Changing

    •   Size Morphing

    •   Piece Splitting

    Controls

    • Move piece

    • ↓: Fast drop

    • ↑/W: Rotate

    • SPACE: Trigger mutation

    • E: Activate special blocks

    • F7: Switch visual style
